output.explanation: The warehouse only has actual orders from 2024-01-01 to 2025-12-31. It has no forecast, budget or plan data, so no query can return a Q1 2026 revenue forecast. Giving a number would mean inventing a forecasting method that isn't in the data or the business definitions. Instead I can return the actual net revenue for Q1 2024 and Q1 2025 (completed orders only, is_revenue = true), with order counts and year-over-year growth, as a starting point for a forecast. Part of the 2025 growth comes from the 4% list price increase on 2025-01-01.
